\documentclass{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{backgrounds}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{scope}[dashed, opacity=0.5, draw=red, text=blue, line width=3pt]
    \begin{pgfonlayer}{background}
      % Black, 0.4pt, solid and opaque on the layer; the text stays blue.
      \draw (0,0) -- (1,1);
      \node at (2,0) {X};
      \clip (0,0) rectangle (3,0.5);
      \draw[orange] (0,0.25) -- (4,0.25);
    \end{pgfonlayer}
    \draw (0,1) -- (2,2);
  \end{scope}
  % The clip set on the layer outside a scope holds for its later content.
  \begin{pgfonlayer}{background}
    \draw[green] (0,0.4) -- (4,0.4);
  \end{pgfonlayer}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
